entry.title: AI can now coach amateur virologists, and top tech leaders want Congress to act on DNA security
entry.summary: Sam Altman, Dario Amodei, Demis Hassabis, and other tech leaders are urging the US government to make screening of synthetic DNA orders a legal requirement. AI systems already outperform PhD-level virologists on lab procedures, the signatories warn, raising the risk of misuse for biological weapons.
